verdict.rationale: The pack contains no probe or documentation of a robots.txt on the Department of State's own host (dos.ny.gov), so nothing shows the service publishes one. The only robots.txt observed is on a different portal, NY Business Express (businessexpress.ny.gov), and it disallows all crawling. That is another service's host, so it cannot be credited to this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
